description: Make a new logo for the user's website when they don't like the current one, without rebuilding the site. Then call get_website_status until logo_state is done or failed, and show logo_url. If message says to publish, pass that on: the logo waits in the editor because the site has other unpublished edits. Do not describe a logo as unique or safe to trademark.

business_name.description: The text on the logo, only if it should change.

logo_style.description: The style the user asked for in a few words, such as playful.

name: regenerate_website_logo
title: Regenerate website logo
